set version 21.4R3-S4.9
set system host-name srx-01
set system root-authentication encrypted-password "$6$lab$hash"
set system login user claude-ro class read-only
set system services ssh
set system services telnet
set system services web-management http interface ge-0/0/0.0
set system services web-management https system-generated-certificate
set system syslog host 10.50.20.50 any any
set snmp community public authorization read-only
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 198.51.100.18/30
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.50.0.1/24
set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 host-inbound-traffic system-services https
set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/0.0 host-inbound-traffic system-services ike
set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 host-inbound-traffic system-services all
